As political alliances shift and the Pope intervenes, John faces rebellion from his own nobles, foreign invasion, and questions of legitimate succession. Filled with battles, betrayals, and power struggles between church and state, the play dramatizes one of England's most contested medieval reigns in a tale of ambition and survival.
